info.name: Sharing Vision — Article API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Sharing Vision backend test (Post Article use case).

Endpoints follow the spec exactly: /article/ (POST), /article/{limit}/{offset} (GET), /article/{id} (GET), /article/{id} (PUT/PATCH), /article/{id} (DELETE).

The public deployment is https://sv.farrel.moe — set the `baseUrl` collection variable when testing locally (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

Validation (spec §4): Title >= 20 chars, Content >= 200 chars, Category >= 3 chars, Status required (publish|draft|thrash). Validation failures return HTTP 422.

request.description: Creates a new article. Validates: title >= 20, content >= 200, category >= 3, status in {publish, draft, thrash}. Returns 201 with the stored article.

Displays all articles with pagination via the {limit}/{offset} path parameters (spec §3 row 2). Response body is a JSON array; the total row count is in the X-Total-Count response header. Append ?status=publish|draft|thrash to filter.
Displays the article corresponding to the requested id (spec §3 row 3). Returns 404 when the id does not exist.
Modifies the article for the requested id (spec §3 row 4). PUT and PATCH are both accepted. Same validation rules as create; failures return 422.
Deletes the article for the requested id (spec §3 row 5). Implemented as a soft delete: the row's Status flips to "thrash" and remains in the database. Returns 204.
Demonstrates spec §4 validation: title < 20, content < 200, category < 3 and an invalid status each produce HTTP 422 with an {"error": "..."} envelope.
